newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga to issue one-for-one rights.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga to issue one-for-one rights.

text.p: Indonesian toll-road builder and operator PT Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada said on Tuesday that it will issue one-for-one rights this month at a price of 500 rupiah per share.
Company finance director Tito Sulistio told reporters that a shareholders meeting earlier in the day had approved the move and that the issue would be completed next month.
He said also that the meeting approved a dividend of 51 rupiah per share for 1996.
